metadata.description: Gudang skill UI/UX & desain untuk Claude Code, dikurasi dari 15 repo open source.

plugins.name: house-style
plugins.description: Gaya desain pribadi: aturan landing page (struktur, copy, SEO, tipografi, spacing, radius, motion) dan cara mendesain di Figma (variables, auto layout, komponen). Prioritas utama di atas skill lain.

plugins.name: antislop
plugins.description: Filter anti AI-slop: UI, copy, layout mobile, aksesibilitas (plus pengecek kontras), dan komentar kode. Sumber: miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop.

plugins.name: design-md
plugins.description: Menulis & memakai DESIGN.md (spesifikasi design system untuk agent), plus 80+ contoh DESIGN.md brand. Sumber: google-labs-code/design.md + VoltAgent/awesome-design-md.

plugins.name: dimensional-drawing
plugins.description: Gambar/ilustrasi dimensional dan versi motion-nya. Sumber: enesozturk/dimensional-drawing.

plugins.name: emil-design
plugins.description: Animasi & design engineering ala Emil Kowalski: animate, review, performa, Apple design, pilih UI library. Sumber: emilkowalski/skills.

plugins.name: gsap
plugins.description: Skill resmi GSAP: core, timeline, ScrollTrigger, plugins, React, performa. Sumber: greensock/gsap-skills.

plugins.name: hallmark
plugins.description: Desain yang tidak terlihat buatan AI: landing page, redesign, tema. Sumber: Nutlope/hallmark.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Kefasihan desain frontend: polish, audit, critique, deteksi anti-pattern. Sumber: pbakaus/impeccable.

plugins.name: magic-ui
plugins.description: Komponen animasi Magic UI (React + Tailwind + shadcn). Sumber: magicuidesign/magicui.

plugins.name: open-design-picks
plugins.description: Pilihan skill UI/web dari OpenDesign: gaya brutalist/minimalist/soft, design brief, redesign, image-to-code, motion, dll. Sumber: nexu-io/open-design.

plugins.name: scroll-world
plugins.description: Landing page sinematik 'terbang menembus dunia' berbasis scroll. Sumber: oso95/scroll-world.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Website perusahaan kelas atas: satu section per layar, foto asli, UI produk asli, dicek di browser. Sumber: Leonxlnx/taste-skill.

plugins.name: ui-libraries
plugins.description: Kapan & cara memasang komponen React Bits dan Canvas UI lewat shadcn registry (kode tidak disalin, lisensi Commons Clause).

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: Database gaya, palet, font pairing, dan panduan UX per stack (React, Next, Vue, Flutter, SwiftUI, dll). Sumber: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill.
